Vice Got a Price!.guide:
Platinum is the last trophy to pop: it needs the other 54, so treat it as a checkpoint rather than a task. Push Square, Output Lag and Sweat School all describe the same single-player route - finish the campaign, work the 100% checklist, then mop up the odd challenge or collectible. Cheats switch off trophies and saving, so keep them away from this save. No online or difficulty trophies stand in your way.
Sources: Push Square, Output Lag, Sweat School.

Just Like Paradise.guide:
The opening mission, Gone Fishing, awards this as soon as you clear its objectives. Push Square lists it among the story trophies that unlock automatically, so follow the mission marker and watch the chapter intro. Keep the starting manual save so you can revisit early-game activities if needed.
Sources: Push Square.

Paradise Lost.guide:
Clear Chapter 1 to collect this bronze. Before you hand the chapter in, check Jason's kitchen in the morning after Down to Earth: Duuro Plays and Output Lag report that Lucia invites you to the balcony meditation there, and that opportunity goes away with the chapter. That step feeds Positive Mental Attitude rather than this trophy, but it is the one early thing worth planning for.
Sources: Push Square, Duuro Plays, Output Lag.

T**s Ass Drug Money.guide:
Finish Chapter 2; Push Square confirms this bronze is a straight story unlock. Most two-character activities open up once both leads are playable, so use the chapter to get comfortable with partner actions rather than rushing. No missable condition is attached to the chapter itself.
Sources: Push Square.

Vice City, Baby!.guide:
Complete Chapter 3 for this story bronze. Output Lag flags a timer-marked race in Yago's street racing strand around this chapter, so save first and take it when it appears if you are collecting Strangers & Freaks. The chapter trophy itself cannot be lost.
Sources: Push Square, Output Lag.

Top Of The World, Ma.guide:
Chapter 4's completion award is this bronze. Push Square's roadmap puts all five chapters in step one and notes that the story can be enjoyed at your own pace. Nothing here is grade- or difficulty-gated.
Sources: Push Square, GTABase.

You Gotta Know When to Get Off.guide:
The final mission pays out this gold; it is one of only two golds on the list. Output Lag recommends leaving an untouched manual save just before it, because there is no mission replay and free roam starts after the credits. Finish the story first - the 100% checklist only appears once this trophy is yours.
Sources: Push Square, Output Lag, GTABase.

Trust.guide:
Breakfast Run is a main-story mission and clearing it pops this bronze. Push Square groups it with the automatic campaign trophies, so no side prerequisite is documented. Keep a manual save before story beats if you want to revisit dialogue choices later.
Sources: Push Square.

Break the Bank.guide:
Complete The Cartel Heist to earn this bronze. It comes from the campaign, not from the random bank-vault robberies tracked by Maximum Withdrawal. Push Square lists it as a straightforward story unlock.
Sources: Push Square.

Family Matters.guide:
Child's Play is the mission to finish here. Push Square marks it as a story trophy with no extra condition, so follow the mission strand to the end. If a cutscene choice matters to you, keep a manual save before starting.
Sources: Push Square.

DWNFALL.guide:
Clear Headliners for this bronze. The official description names the mission directly, and Push Square's list treats it as another automatic campaign unlock. No missable window is reported for it.
Sources: Push Square.

Hi-Jacked.guide:
VCIA Takedown awards this bronze on completion. Push Square lists it with the story set, and Output Lag's no-replay rule is the only reason to save beforehand. You do not need to satisfy Catch Me If You Can first; those are separate objectives.
Sources: Push Square, Output Lag.

Snow Storm.guide:
Operation Savage Glory is the last of the named campaign missions that hand out these bronze story trophies. Push Square confirms the unlock is automatic once the mission ends. After the credits, the 100% checklist becomes your main job.
Sources: Push Square.

A Long Road.guide:
This gold needs 100% Completion, which appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story. PowerPyx and Duuro Plays summarise the big targets: 70 of 80 Challenges, 300 Stunts, all 33 underwater discoveries, all 42 shooting-range golds, 15 of 18 card sets, 200 WAiNK scans, 100 animal species, 100 optional jobs and 15 meditations. Earlier work still counts, so chip away during the campaign and batch the rest in free roam. Track every category from the in-game list rather than guessing.
Sources: PowerPyx, Duuro Plays, Push Square, GTABase.

Cunning Stunts.guide:
Complete 250 of the 397 stunts to get this silver. Push Square breaks them into stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps, with 300 needed for 100% completion. Base jumps and bridge flyunders are usually the quickest to repeat, and the map's Exploration layer shows discovered spots. Only stunt-jump medals are extra work, so ignore those unless you want them.
Sources: Push Square, Sweat School, Output Lag.

Master of None.guide:
Sample each of the nine activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, a basketball hoop, an arcade game, a race or drone race, and a stunt. Sweat School spells out that nine-type list while Push Square confirms the count. Most are marked on the map under Activities, so plan a short tour rather than hunting them down at random. Nothing here is missable.
Sources: Sweat School, Push Square.

The Shootist.guide:
Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges for this silver. Push Square names Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero as the two venues; PowerPyx lists 14 ranges with 42 golds in total. Each challenge has three tiers and some are locked until you meet their listed condition. Check the Activities > Shooting Ranges screen after every visit so you can see what is left.
Sources: Push Square, PowerPyx.

Top Fun.guide:
Win at least one Top Fun drone time trial at each of the 14 locations. PowerPyx counts 42 trials across those sites, while Push Square notes that some events ask for an entry fee. Discovered sites appear under Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones. Finish a location's race in first place, not just within the time, to make it count.
Sources: Push Square, PowerPyx.

Earn Cash, Not Kudos.guide:
Win 20 different races for this bronze; repeating one event will not move the counter. PowerPyx lists 40 unique races spread over six groups, and Push Square suggests hiring cars or upgrading your own at a Mod Shop if the rating is too low. Work through the map's Racing menu and tick off each venue once. No online racing is involved.
Sources: Push Square, PowerPyx.

Baited My Tackle.guide:
Cal's early request asks you to beat his fishing mark, a Parrotfish above 2kg according to Push Square. Fish inside the marked water, and borrow a boat with a rod if you do not own one yet. The trophy pops when your catch beats his, so keep trying in the same spot rather than travelling elsewhere.
Sources: Push Square.

Stick Fiddler.guide:
Finish one arcade game to collect this bronze. PowerPyx's database records four arcade/video games in Leonida, so pick whichever is nearest and play it through to the end. The same venues also help Master of None, as an arcade game is one of the nine activity types. There is no score target in the official description.
Sources: PowerPyx Collectibles, Push Square.

Road to Rehabilitation.guide:
Work through Andy's contact missions until his last one is cleared; that finale pops the bronze. Push Square describes it as the final mission in his strand and lists no extra requirement. Contact missions stay available in free roam, so you can finish this after the credits.
Sources: Push Square.

This Was No Boat Accident.guide:
Kenton's strand ends with Maritime Disputes, and Push Square names that mission as the unlock. Finish it to earn the bronze. Since there is no mission replay, save before starting if you want to redo the lead-up, but the trophy itself is not missable.
Sources: Push Square.

The Lone Rider.guide:
Finish Billy's mission strand; Push Square identifies Hometown Heroes as his last mission and the trophy trigger. Take the contact calls as they appear or revisit them in free roam. Nothing in the cited guides marks a time limit on this one.
Sources: Push Square.

Strangers & Freaks.guide:
Complete eight separate stranger mission strands across Leonida for this silver. Output Lag singles out Yago's timed street race in Chapter 3 as the one to grab immediately when its hourglass appears, and says it feeds this trophy's count. Keep a chapter save before starting strands, because finished missions cannot be replayed. The other seven can be cleaned up after the story.
Sources: Output Lag, Push Square, GTABase.

Supply & Demand.guide:
Randy's final contact mission unlocks this bronze. Push Square points to Randy's wish-list vehicle locations as the way to push his strand forward. Finish the last job to collect the trophy; the vehicles themselves are separate collectibles.
Sources: Push Square.

Spin On This!.guide:
Clear Tyrone's last mission for this bronze. Push Square mentions the Kitty Litter Lab locations as part of his chain, so work through those when they are offered. The finale is available in free roam if you miss it during the campaign.
Sources: Push Square.

Positive Mental Attitude.guide:
Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida; Push Square notes that a meditation only counts once the final zen animation finishes. The risky one is Lucia's balcony invitation in Chapter 1: Duuro Plays and Output Lag place it in Jason's kitchen in the morning after Down to Earth, and it disappears when the chapter ends. Follow her out, accept the prompt and complete it before moving on, then keep that chapter save until the trophy pops. The 100% checklist needs only 15 meditations, so this is the one clearly flagged missable trophy on the list.
Sources: PowerPyx, Duuro Plays, Output Lag, Push Square, Sweat School.

Fair Game.guide:
Bret asks for a unique animal hunt, and this bronze follows when you deliver it. PowerPyx's database lists Bret's Target Decks under hunting, so treat those as the route into his request. Use binoculars to study and track the quarry before taking the shot. The offer is a side activity that stays available after the story.
Sources: Push Square, PowerPyx Collectibles.

Don't Touch My Deck.guide:
Complete every card in three of the 18 Collectible Card sets for this silver. Pro-Gamer's set guide and PowerPyx list the full 480-card database; Push Square adds that selling duplicates at pawn shops still leaves progress intact. Aim for 15 full sets if you want A Long Road as well, since that is the 100% requirement. Check Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards to see which sets are closest.
Sources: Pro-Gamer, PowerPyx Collectibles, Push Square.

You WAiNKer!.guide:
Scan 100 valid WAiNK locations for this silver. Push Square sorts them into landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags, and PowerPyx lists roughly 31, 35 and 23 of the first three plus the tag markings. Duuro Plays separately recommends scanning unfamiliar vehicles along the way because 200 base-model scans feed 100% completion. Hold Up for the app and use Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations to watch the tally.
Sources: Push Square, PowerPyx Collectibles, Duuro Plays.

One Last Thing.guide:
Finish 50 of the 80 Challenges for this bronze. Push Square notes that 70 are needed for 100%, so you can leave the awkward ones until late. All requirements are visible under Progress > Challenges. Many clear naturally during normal play, so check the list before grinding anything specific.
Sources: Push Square, Sweat School.

Hot Together.guide:
Get both leads together, push the wanted meter to four stars and then stay out of sight until the heat clears; the official line requires the partner to be with you and to escape. Push Square and Output Lag list the trophy without a more detailed confirmed recipe, so treat the description as the requirement. Save before attempting it and keep cheats off, as they disable trophies. If it does not pop, repeat the sequence in a clean free-roam session rather than during a mission.
Sources: Push Square, Output Lag.

Retail Therapy.guide:
With your partner alongside you, rob three shops back to back without letting the wanted level drop between them. Push Square and Output Lag reproduce the official condition but do not give a named shop chain, so chain nearby stores quickly and use a getaway route you know. Avoid losing the police at any point in the sequence. Since no story mission is involved, you can retry in free roam as often as you like.
Sources: Push Square, Output Lag.

Whip It Good.guide:
Discover 100 different vehicles by driving or scanning them; Push Square says either action registers one. PowerPyx counts 557 vehicles in total, of which 277 are base models, and Duuro Plays notes that 200 base-model scans are a separate 100% target. Check Progress > Vehicles to see gaps while you play. This usually clears on its own during the campaign.
Sources: Push Square, PowerPyx Collectibles, Duuro Plays.

Gunslinger.guide:
Activate Combat Focus and drop five enemies during that single use. Neither Push Square nor Output Lag publishes a verified location or loadout for it, so pick a busy enemy encounter and save just before you trigger Focus. Line up clustered targets before activating rather than burning it on the first guard. Retry in free roam if the fifth takedown lands after the meter ends.
Sources: Push Square, Output Lag.

Catch Me If You Can.guide:
The trophy asks for an unscheduled departure at VCIA, which reads as leaving the airport without going through the normal route. Push Square and Output Lag only restate that line, with no confirmed step-by-step, so experiment near the airfield on a save you can reload. Keep the wanted level and cheats out of the equation while testing. No story mission is required by the official text.
Sources: Push Square, Output Lag.

Challenging Tank.guide:
The official wording points at Leonida's Rhino tanks; the cited lists give no confirmed trigger beyond that. Push Square and Output Lag both print the description without a walkthrough, so treat tank encounters as the place to experiment and save beforehand. Try engaging or escaping a Rhino on foot or in a vehicle and check the trophy after each attempt. Do not use cheats to spawn one on your trophy save.
Sources: Push Square, Output Lag.

Sneakthief.guide:
Rob a jewellery store without being detected. PowerPyx counts 20 smash-and-grab jewellery sites, so there is no shortage of attempts. Use a stealth approach, watch the cameras and leave without raising the alarm to satisfy the undetected wording. Push Square confirms the condition but adds no named location.
Sources: Push Square, PowerPyx Collectibles.

Maximum Withdrawal.guide:
Rob five bank vaults and get away each time for this silver. PowerPyx lists eight large banks with vaults among 22 bank jobs in total, so you can pick the ones with the easiest escapes. Push Square's version of the list grades this trophy silver, not bronze. Mark each successful vault on your own checklist because the game counter is the only other record.
Sources: Push Square, PowerPyx Collectibles, Output Lag.

A Classic Blitz Play.guide:
Pull off an armoured-truck robbery and escape with the cash. PowerPyx groups armoured trucks among the game's 11 robbery types but does not pin down a fixed spawn in the reference text. Push Square gives no further steps, so watch for the truck during free roam and save before the attempt. A clean getaway is part of the stated condition.
Sources: Push Square, PowerPyx Collectibles.

The Goodtime State.guide:
Reveal the whole Leonida map by exploring it. Sweat School suggests a plane as the fastest way to clear the fog, and GTABase includes map exploration in its step-one advice. Use the map screen to spot the remaining grey areas and sweep them in a few flights. All travel counts, so this happens naturally while chasing other counters.
Sources: Sweat School, GTABase, Push Square.

Pest Control.guide:
Rob one illegal operation for each of Leonida's nine gangs. PowerPyx records nine gangs with 39 gang operations, so you only need a single success from each gang. Push Square lists the trophy without naming preferred sites. Check the map's gang-operation layer and keep a tally per gang to avoid repeating one crew.
Sources: Push Square, PowerPyx Collectibles.

In The Beginning….guide:
Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, as the official line says. Push Square and Output Lag print the description without a named venue or time, so look for a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach and stay for the drink. Take the trophy during free roam rather than inside a mission. Save first if you want to try more than one spot.
Sources: Push Square, Output Lag.

Capital Offense.guide:
Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The cited guides give only the description, so drive a vehicle into a showroom and force your way back out, then check whether it counts. Push Square and Output Lag do not name a particular store or car. Save before smashing up property in case the attempt needs repeating.
Sources: Push Square, Output Lag.

Let’s Go Bowling.guide:
Complete a full follow-through at Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Push Square repeats the official wording and names the venue, so head there and finish a game properly rather than walking away mid-throw. The alley is a normal activity in free roam. It also covers the bowling-type activity for Master of None if you have not sampled it yet.
Sources: Push Square.

Personal Best.guide:
Push Square and Sweat School both list this trophy with the cryptic line about a partnership with mass appeal and no confirmed unlock method. Since the description points at the two leads working together, spend time on joint activities and check the trophy after each new partnership milestone. Keep cheats off and play on your main save so any pop is registered. Do not treat this as missable - nothing in the cited guides says so.
Sources: Push Square, Sweat School.

Actions Speak Louder.guide:
The official text mentions choices made, for better or worse, but the cited guides give no exact count or mission. Push Square and Sweat School simply list the trophy, so make the story decisions as they come and keep the trophy save clean. Because there is no mission replay, keep chapter saves if you want to explore different outcomes. Reaching the credits should settle whether it has popped.
Sources: Push Square, Sweat School.

Bad Luck, I Guess.guide:
The line about the second time being charming is all the official description offers, and Push Square and Sweat School provide no verified trigger. Watch for activities that invite a retry after an initial failure and try them a second time on your trophy save. Check Progress after each attempt instead of assuming a single event is required. It is not listed as missable by any cited guide.
Sources: Push Square, Sweat School.

The Truth Is Out There.guide:
Push Square and Sweat School only reproduce the baffled reaction in the official description; no guide in the reference set confirms a precise event. Stay alert for unusual world encounters while exploring Leonida, especially during free roam after the story. Save before chasing any strange sighting so you can repeat it if needed. Count it as an exploration curiosity rather than a story requirement.
Sources: Push Square, Sweat School.

Ten Pin.guide:
Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, which is how the official melee drive-by line reads. Push Square and Sweat School list the trophy without a named spot, so find a quiet street, get up to speed and time the strike. Save first and repeat on a clean save if the game does not register it. Comedy value is guaranteed either way.
Sources: Push Square, Sweat School.

Dime on the Dollar.guide:
Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts to clear this bronze. Push Square and Output Lag repeat the money target, so bank the bills and use the contact route rather than regular shops. Watch the cash total on the laundering screen as you go. This is pure bookkeeping - no missable window is attached.
Sources: Push Square, Output Lag.

Treat Yo Self.guide:
Spend $100,000 across Leonida's shops. Push Square calls this the simplest trophy: open the Style menu to locate shops, buy whatever you like and keep going until the total is reached. Clothes, parts and upgrades all count as ordinary spending. No need to hoard cash once your properties are bought.
Sources: Push Square.

Little Boxes.guide:
Buy all eight garage properties through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone. Push Square lists the eight sites and puts the combined price around $160,000, so save up before starting. Each garage adds a vehicle slot, which also helps On the Spot. Once the last deed is signed, the trophy is yours.
Sources: Push Square.

On the Spot.guide:
Register 10 vehicles with the Scooter Bros app. Push Square explains that registration happens at a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop and needs a free parking spot, so buy garages first if you are short. The fee changes with the vehicle's value, but any 10 registered vehicles count. Check the app's list to see how many are already logged.
Sources: Push Square.
